## Most recent role (Enttor, Jun 2025 - Jul 2026)

Built the AI outbound engine and browser-automation flows for Instagram and LinkedIn prospecting, Next.js dashboards, NestJS APIs, Vercel infra, and the Supabase + Inngest backend.

Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Inngest, Vercel, OpenAI

## Past

- **Samsam** (Feb 2024 – Mar 2025), Founding engineer at an e-commerce platform. Shopper and merchant apps in TypeScript, React Native, Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL.
- **Universidad de los Andes** (Jan 2024 – Jul 2025), Graduate teaching assistant in parallel with the M.Sc.
- Earlier work crossed data analytics (SQL models, Power BI for HR / risk / operations) and deep learning on satellite imagery for cropland and environmental risk detection.
